comparison.exact: source/input hashes, structure and scope labels

domain.auxiliary_exponential_amplitudes: deterministic forcing integration only; not new physical degrees of freedom
domain.computational_edges: zero right incoming DIFFERENCE, left outflow; no reflecting carrier
domain.energy_samples: inherited derivative-control real frequencies; not a complete covariance integral
domain.initial_data: zero difference; authenticated reference mode columns, not seed covariance
domain.metric_selection: none; a supplied response history is an argument of the propagator
domain.operator: same full transmitting canonical Dirac field on PG slices
domain.state_preparation: same C_H plus inherited occupation; preparation unchanged at pulse start

gate.Gamma_rest_extra_term: none introduced; full Gaussian action counted once
gate.homogeneous_nonexistence: imported in its original scope, not rerun
gate.physical_endpoint_family: not selected by these response histories
gate.remaining_state_integral: retain all real panels, analytic subgap representation and tail; no complex contour node promoted to canonical frequency

numerical_control.refinement_scope: measured differences of sampled response kernels, not rigorous whole-spectrum error bounds
numerical_control.spatial_method: owned second-order diagonal-norm split SBP/SAT convention
numerical_control.time_envelope: inherited C-infinity compact profile; all endpoint derivatives vanish
numerical_control.time_method: midpoint coefficients; sparse exponential with exact exponential forcing within each step
